news.title: RAM and SSD prices are surging 300–500% — here is why and what to do instead
news.excerpt: RAM and SSD prices have jumped 300–500% in 2026 because AI data centers are buying all the memory chips. If you were planning a memory upgrade, wait — prices may not drop until 2027–2028. Or buy a refurbished business laptop with 16–32 GB RAM already installed — search "refurbished ThinkPad T14" on eBay.com or backmarket.com.

news.title: Windows 11 July 2026 Update (KB5101650) Fixes 570 Vulnerabilities, Adds Point-in-Time Restore
news.excerpt: Get the update via Settings → Windows Update → Check for updates, or download KB5101650 manually from the Microsoft Update Catalog.

news.title: FTC Warns: Fake CAPTCHA Scams Hijack Your Computer
news.excerpt: Scammers use fake CAPTCHAs that tell you to press Windows+R, paste, and Enter — this runs malicious code. Real CAPTCHAs never ask for keyboard commands. Close the tab immediately if a verification asks you to open Run or paste anything.

news.title: 16 Billion Stolen Passwords: Check If Yours Are Out There
news.excerpt: A massive database of 16 billion stolen usernames and passwords is circulating. Check haveibeenpwned.com and change reused passwords immediately. Use a password manager like Bitwarden.

news.title: 🔴 ALERT — Tech Support Scams: The Phone Call That Costs You Everything
news.excerpt: Scammers pose as Microsoft Support, claim they detected a virus, and demand remote access. Once inside they steal files, drain bank accounts, or lock you out. Microsoft, Apple, and Google NEVER call you out of the blue. Hang up immediately. If worried about your computer, call someone you trust or bring it to the shop. Tech support phone scams cost Americans over $500M last year — average loss $400–$600.

posts.title: Firefox adds HDR video, QR code sharing, and PDF merging — free at firefox.com
posts.summary: Firefox (released July 21, 2026) adds HDR video playback on Windows, QR code sharing from any page (right-click → Share → Generate QR Code), and drag-and-drop PDF merging in the built-in PDF editor. Download free at firefox.com or update via Menu → Help → About Firefox.
posts.truth: Most people don't realize their browser can do more than show web pages. Firefox's PDF editor now lets you combine multiple PDFs by dragging one into the sidebar of another — no Adobe Acrobat subscription needed. The QR code trick is handy for sending a page from your computer to your phone without emailing yourself. And HDR video means movies and YouTube actually look right on an HDR screen. Download free at firefox.com or update via Menu → Help → About Firefox.

posts.title: Run your own private AI chatbot offline free — Jan.ai installs in minutes at jan.ai
posts.summary: Jan.ai is a free, open-source app that runs AI models entirely on your PC — no internet, no account, no data leaves your machine. Download at jan.ai or github.com/janhq/jan/releases. Needs 8 GB+ RAM; works on Windows, Mac, and Linux.
posts.truth: I get asked about AI all the time. People want to try it but don't want their questions sent to some company's server. Jan.ai solves that — it downloads a model and runs it locally. Your chats stay on your computer. It's not as polished as ChatGPT, but for drafting emails, summarizing PDFs, or brainstorming, it's genuinely useful and costs nothing.

posts.title: Windows 11 File Explorer Now Deletes Large Files Significantly Faster
posts.summary: Update to Windows 11 July 2026 update (KB5101650) via Windows Update to get the faster File Explorer deletion.
posts.truth: Lake City customers bring in laptops choking on old downloads and temp folders. Deleting thousands of small files used to freeze File Explorer for minutes. Microsoft finally fixed the underlying I/O path in the July update — large folder deletions now finish in seconds instead of minutes. I still see machines with 50+ GB in Downloads folders because people don't know how to clean them.

posts.title: Major Password Breaches: 85 Million Records Exposed — Check Yours Now
posts.summary: Two massive breaches hit this month: Abbott Labs lost 30M+ cancer records (SSNs, medical histories, insurance). Suno AI leaked 55M users' names, emails, and partial payment data. If you reused a password anywhere, criminals are testing it on banks, email, and shopping sites. Go to HaveIBeenPwned.com — if your email shows, change that password everywhere. Use unique passwords per account (Bitwarden/1Password/KeePass) and enable 2FA on email and banking today.
posts.truth: Credential stuffing attacks are automated. Bots try your leaked email/password combo on thousands of sites in minutes. One reused password = open door. ONYX SYSTEMS helps customers check and secure their accounts.

posts.title: Turn On Windows Storage Sense to Automatically Free 5–50 GB Monthly
posts.summary: Open Settings → System → Storage → Storage Sense → Turn on. Set cleanup schedule to "During low free disk space" or "Monthly." Configure cleanup schedules for temp files, Recycle Bin (30 days), and Downloads folder (60 days).
posts.truth: Lake City FL customers bring in laptops with 5 GB free on a 256 GB drive. They don't know Storage Sense exists. It's built into Windows 11 — no download, no cost, no ads. I've seen it reclaim 40 GB on a single laptop in one run. Most people never touch Storage settings until the red bar appears.

posts.title: Fix a Spotty Wi-Fi Connection in 3 Minutes
posts.summary: Unplug your router's power cord, wait 30 full seconds, plug it back in. Wait two minutes for all lights to settle. This clears stuck connections and memory leaks that slow things down. If it's still slow, move the router off the floor, away from thick walls and the microwave — signals travel better with breathing room.
posts.truth: Lake City customers bring in 'slow internet' that's actually just a router that hasn't been rebooted in months. A power cycle fixes 70% of cases. The other 30% need repositioning — I've seen routers in closets, behind TVs, next to microwaves. ONYX SYSTEMS optimizes home Wi-Fi in one visit.
